provenance.label: 亡者 move
provenance.subject: A frail pitiable elderly deceased commoner, hunched narrow shoulders, emaciated gray-white skin, hollow tired eyes, ragged gray-brown burial cloth, small bare hands and worn wraps. Not muscular and not armored. Weaker and smaller than an undead warrior.
provenance.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Input1 is the EXACT pixel character. Input2 is ONLY a six-phase leg-motion diagram, RED means same near leg and BLUE means same far leg; do NOT copy its colors, text, mannequin or style. Draw the input1 character with the leg phases of input2, matching camera, head/torso size, palette, outfit and accessories throughout. The near leg MUST move from FORWARD-right in frame1 to BACK-left in frame4, while far leg does opposite. Inframe2 nearlegsupportsunderhips farfootlifted,inframe3nearlegtrailsleft farfootadvancesright,inframe5farlegsupports nearfootlifted,inframe6nearlegadvancesright farlegtrailsleft. Feet point RIGHT even while leg is behind hips. Arms swing oppositely; retain weapon in hand for archer. NO repeating same bright near foot forward in both contact poses.  Exactly SIX poses 3columns by2rows readingorder, each logical64x64px with2pxtransparentmargin, body50px high; fixed footbaseline and exact identical scale. Compact stride fits frame. Transparent binarypixelart, exact input1 RGB palette, no scene/text/grid/shadow/FX/particles, no redblue guide colors.

provenance.label: 亡者 attack
provenance.subject: A frail pitiable elderly deceased commoner, hunched narrow shoulders, emaciated gray-white skin, hollow tired eyes, ragged gray-brown burial cloth, small bare hands and worn wraps. Not muscular and not armored. Weaker and smaller than an undead warrior.
provenance.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Animate the EXACT project character in input1. Preserve head/face, proportions, materials, palette, clothing, armor and accessories. Four poses:1 neutral low hands;2 pull near hand back and lean slightly away;3 reach/grab sharply RIGHT with near arm extended and fingers spread, far arm follows;4 recoil to neutral. Same thin body and cloth in every frame. No large magic, weapon or trails.
Layout: EXACTLY FOUR frames in a2by2equal-cell grid, reading left-to-right then top-to-bottom. Each cell logically64x64pixels, with2logicalpixels of completely clear margin on every side. Fixed side-three-quarter camera facing RIGHT. Every cell has SAME scale, body size, foot ground line and lighting as reference. Frame1 has the original neutral body size for reference. Do not shrink the character to make extended poses fit: draw compact poses instead.
Strong low-resolution pixel clusters, exactly the same limited RGB color palette as reference, upper-left light, dark outline, no dithering or smooth painting. Genuine transparent RGBA, binary alpha. No frame lines, text, labels, names, scene, separate object, ground shadow, aura, slash, dust or particle effects. Whole character/weapon fits inside every frame. No cut-off limbs or detached limbs.

postprocess.operation: remove single isolated crop-boundary alpha speck and re-center whole last frame
